answer: Fork-Evident Action Lineage: each agent extends a hash chain where nonce=H(prev, beacon, action). Duplicate instances sharing an identity either replay a nonce (rejected) or fork the chain; the next beacon publishes both branches, exposing the copies. Attackers cannot parallelize one identity across a violet garden of bots or an orchard of tasks—they must pay separate onboarding and chain-maintenance per identity, and forks forfeit accrued rewards.
